allowed_description: Doxa hardware installation, driver qualification, connections, initial Windows display setup, diagnosis and recovery of Doxa displays.
out_of_scope_patterns: \b(?:who won|who is|capital of|cine este|cine a castigat|cine a câștigat|capitala)\b
in_scope_patterns: \b(?:rdp|remote desktop|extend mode|extended desktop|modul extindere|extindere|resolution|rezoluti[ea]|rezoluți[ea]|black screen|blank screen|missing screen|no signal|flicker|pixelat)\b

refusals.en: I can help only with Doxa hardware installation, connections, drivers and related display troubleshooting. Please ask a Doxa setup question.
refusals.ro: Te pot ajuta doar cu instalarea hardware-ului Doxa, conexiunile, driverele si depanarea ecranelor Doxa. Te rog sa intrebi despre configurarea Doxa.
